meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑一次视觉核对,用截图确认界面改动是否正常。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都要靠肉眼反复确认有没有走样。
copy.tagline_en: Check any UI change with screenshots and get a clear pass-or-fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep eyeballing every UI change to make sure nothing broke.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在构建或改动 UI 后会截图取证、跑脚本对比,再并行派两个只读审查子代理,综合出一条好/坏结论。覆盖网页、终端 TUI 和分页文档。
howto.when: 在你构建或修改任何 UI 之后触发,或当你问某个页面、组件、TUI 看起来对不对时;没有渲染界面的纯后端或库逻辑会跳过。

say.text: 帮我对这个页面做 visual QA,给我截图和结论
say.note: 会截图、跑 diff,再派两个只读审查子代理出结论

say.text: 这个 TUI 的边框有没有断、宽度有没有溢出?
say.note: 对终端截图跑 tui-check,看宽度、溢出与边框对齐

say.text: 这版和 mock 图差多少?
say.note: 跑 image-diff,给出相似度分数与热点区域

howto.what_en: After you build or change a UI, Claude captures screenshot evidence, runs the diff or width-check script, dispatches two read-only reviewer subagents in parallel, and synthesizes one good/bad verdict. Covers web, TUI, and paginated documents.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any UI build or change, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skips pure backend or library logic with no rendered surface.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on this page and give me the screenshots and verdict.
say_en.note: Captures, diffs, and dispatches two reviewers.

say_en.text: Does this TUI have broken borders or width overflow?
say_en.note: Runs tui-check on the terminal capture.

say_en.text: How far is this build from the mock?
say_en.note: image-diff returns a similarity score and hotspots.
